title: Program amasung Source Code kari no?
learningObjectives: Program-gi meaning adubu masagi words-ta explain touba amasung mahak computer-na execute touba instructions-gi organised group-ni haiba khangba ngamgani.
Source Code-gi definition adubu explain touba amasung mahak human-na pariba Programming Language-da isingba haiba identify touba ngamgani.
Program amasung Source Code-gi relation adubu explain touba amasung ani terms adubu same meaning-da sijinnaba mistake adubu thok-hanba ngamgani.
Daily task adubu small, clear amasung order-gi instructions-da divide touba ngamgani.
Simple example amada Input, Processing amasung Output-gi role adubu explain touba ngamgani.
Ordinary language-da isingba instructions amasung Programming Language-gi rules matung inba Source Code-gi difference adubu hairiba ngamgani.
Language matung inna Compiler, Interpreter nattraga Runtime-na Source Code execute touba-da karamna help touba adubu explain touba ngamgani.
Small Code example amada instructions-gi order identify touba amasung each instruction-gi work adubu hairiba ngamgani.
Syntax amasung clarity-gi importance adubu khangba amasung unclear instructions-na wrong result karamna piribano adubu explain touba ngamgani.
Problem amagi maramda required instructions choose touba amasung expected result adubu hairiba ngamgani.
Program adubu small steps-da explain, test amasung improve touba-gi benefit adubu identify touba ngamgani.
Variables, Conditions, Loops amasung Functions learn touba-gi basic understanding adubu develop touba ngamgani.

understand.concept: Program haibadi instructions-gi organised group amani, madu computer-na task amabu complete touba execute touba ngamgani. Source Code haibadi Programming Language-gi rules matung inna programmer-na isingba, human-na pariba ngamgani instructions-gi written form-ni. Program ama oina create touba matamda Source Code use toui. Adubu Source Code, running Program, mahakna touba actions amasung mahakki result-sing asi makhoi amadi mari leinaba oirabasu amukta oiba nattre.
understand.whyItMatters: Programming-gi houdokpa matamda problem amabu computer-na exact follow touba ngamgani clear instructions-da transform toui. Problem, solution-gi plan, Source Code amasung running Program-gi marakta leiriba difference khangba aduna Code isingba matamda eikhoina kari create toulibano haiba clear oihalli. Maduna Data, Decisions amasung Repetition-gi matung-inna lakpa topics-sing sijinnaba foundation oina thajabani.
understand.history: Computer amasung Programming Languages development touba matamda Program isingba-gi method-singsu change toukhi. Ahoubada Hardware-ga marakta leiriba instructions-sing sijinnarammi. Matungda mi-singna makhoigi ideas adu henna pariba ngamgani form-da isingba ngamhanba Languages-sing develop toukhi. Houjik Languages amasung Tools kaya leirabasu, basic idea adu amukta oina leiri: computer system-na process touba ngamgani exact instructions-da solution adu express touba. Language khudingmakki detailed history adugi related Module-da teach tougani.
understand.analogy: Chak-thingba Recipe amabu khannabi. Maduda ingredients amasung touba matamgi steps-sing isingba leiri. Adugi steps-sing follow touba adu Program execute touba-ga mannei. Isingba Recipe adu Source Code-ga compare touba ngammi, maramdi anina kari tougadage haiba describe toui.
understand.analogyLimit: Asi exact comparison amadi nattre. Mi-singna makhoigi experience sijinnaduna incomplete Recipe adu khangba amasung missing step adu guess touba ngammi. Computer-na Programming Language-gi rules amasung Program-da piba instructions-sing follow toui; common sense sijinnaduna missing instructions-sing safe oina complete toude.

explain.narrative:
Program kari touna create toui amasung kari touna work toui haiba khangnaba, ideas mari asi separate tou: problem, solution-gi plan, Source Code amasung running Program.

Ahoubada problem adu identify tou. Example oina, “anima number-gi sum adu find touba” asi task amani, Code nattre. Matungda plan ama tou: first number adu lou, second number adu lou, anina add tou amasung total adu display tou. Asi specific Programming Language amada depend toude. Maduda Input haibadi numbers ani, Processing haibadi makhoi add touba, Output haibadi total adu oiri.

Ordinary language-da isingba plan adu mi-singgi mateng oiri, adubu madu automatic oina Source Code oirakde. Source Code oihannaba Programming Language-gi words, symbols amasung Syntax rules matung inna instructions-sing isingba darkar oiri. Example oina JavaScript-da Variables, + Operator amasung console.log() sijinnaduna plan adu isingba ngammi. Karamba words amasung symbols sijinnagadage haibadu selected Language-da depend toui.

Program execute toudringeida nattraga execute touba matamda computer system-na Source Code adu process toui. Method adu Language amasung mahakki Implementation-da depend toui. Compiler-na Code adu other form-da convert touba ngammi; Interpreter-na instructions execute touba ngammi; Runtime-na Program run touba matamda required services piba ngammi. Khara Languages amasung Tools-na methods asi combine toui. Maram aduna Program pumnamakna always Compiler khaktak nattraga Interpreter khaktak sijinnai haiba correct nattre.

Program run touba matamda mahakki instructions-sing Data-da work toui. Result adu Output koui. Output haibadi screen-da display touba message khaktani haiba nattre. Madu Text, File, saved change, calculation result nattraga other System-da send touba information oiba ngammi. Program run toudeba matamda su Source Code adu File oina leiba ngammi. Running Program haibadi instructions execute touba process-ni; Source Code File-gi text khaktani nattre.

A good habit haibadi small Program execute toudringeida mahakna kari tougani haiba predict tou, aduga actual result-ga compare tou. Difference leirabadi instructions, makhoigi order, Input values amasung Language Syntax check tou. Madugi matung-inna idea adu reliable solution-da transform toui.

examples.explanation: Number touba steps-singna specific Programming Language amatta sijinnadringeida solution-gi plan adu describe toui. JavaScript Statements-na plan adu JavaScript Syntax-da express toui. const Statements-na values ani-gi names piri; + Operator-na makhoibu add toui; console.log()-na result adu Console-da send toui. Instructions execute touba matamda Output 13 oiri. Source Code haibadi written instructions-singni; 13 haibadi makhoibu execute touba matamda phangba result-ni.

practise.guidedTask: Items ani-gi total price calculate touba small Program ama khannabi. Ordinary language-da steps mari leiba plan ama isingbi. Required values-sing adu Input, add touba action adu Processing, amasung calculated total price adu Output oina identify tou. Plan adu Source Code oihannaba karamba part adu Programming Language-da amuk isingba darkar gadage haiba explain tou.
practise.independentTask: Minutes adu seconds-da convert touba nattraga items ani-gi total price find touba oiba simple task ama choose tou. Language-independent plan ama isingbi amasung Input, Processing, Output identify tou. Matungda plan adu Source Code oina kari touba ngamgadage haiba explain tou. Plan, Source Code amasung Program execute touba matungda phangba result-gi difference adu clear oina describe tou.
hints: Instructions isingdringeida problem adu clear oina state tou.
Input haibadi required Data-ni; Processing haibadi Data aduda touba work-ni; Output haibadi result-ni.
Ordinary language-da isingba plan adu automatic oina Source Code oirakde.
Source Code isingba matamda selected Programming Language-gi Syntax rules follow tou.
Instructions execute touba matamda Output phang-i; Output adu Source Code nattre.
